summary:
I independently read the authoritative Fixed native-ownership output in revision 2 section in docs/superpowers/specs/node-v2-installed-lifecycle.md at commit 68aed163fb165e9ef2d9b59acb5b43b4f990a2d4, raw Norm SHA256 0051a57b4bfec08efcd8e0d08ea011b0c9c7621ab060b8f22df833a913136d93, and compared it with the exact independently reviewed original design a6c2ba087d9e3bcf39b03242447eccabaabc9e6e2d018879ac6d2ffebf6d4765 and applicability supplement 12cc193ec0ec95b2785b81dff0099ea94cb5047ac3c1e154ab892551053ccd06. This is a new genuine independent design review of that specific Norm addition; the earlier REV-0001 is historical and is not represented as having reviewed it. The source design context builder currently still returns b13e8c443f364704fd285d5bfd9a1b514b8d6c8af2b9238e08491c289e15ac44; that digest does not bind the new Norm text, so this summary explicitly binds the reviewed commit and raw document digest.

The new Norm accurately carries the reviewed closed output contract: the same before-product/before-prepared-write role applicability state for revision-2 V0, V1 and V2; both roles absent forbids cache and fixture entry; one role, unsupported pin or unsafe identity rejects early; both exact reviewed roles require the actual successful fixed node_check Job/EOF/cleanup receipt and immediate complete two-file seal. Exact source/producer and existing tool/material bindings, source-addressed names, ordinary files/single links/no-reparse constraints, exact closed two-digest sidecar wire and all original budgets remain required. The sidecar and caller inventory never grant roles or execution authority. Every remaining fixed execution and plan completion preserve the same first seal, including the second full coverage suite. Successful replay rederives applicability, checks the actual fixed success receipt and original role, and compares content/identity/membership and existing run/snapshot/review/approval bindings. Failed or unreached checks retain actual bounded partial diagnostics without fabricated success shapes, repair, cleanup or recompilation. Unknown runtime neighbors remain rejected on successful paths.

This is the existing dist trusted-host output model, not independent CS-to-IL certification or authentication against a host able to forge every receipt and original. No historical EXE hash, PE normalization, independent recompilation, trace framework, public command, check, receipt stage or authority schema is added. Revision 1, Policy/schema, fixed argv, process/inventory/JSON budgets, 85/90 thresholds and the original base-to-current denominator remain unchanged. The native artifact reader adds no process launch; the Norm preceding this section still explicitly acknowledges existing Git authority collection in top-level Node recheck, so this review does not call the entire top-level entry point zero-process.

The prior independent high design finding NATIVE-OUT-001 is preserved in build/adoption/node-v2-native-output-design-review.json (SHA e1bf6da952203303458c49f0471dcfba49e821551636beb9cb0ac6fd9a275965). Its design-only closure is build/adoption/native-output-design-review-r2.json (SHA 8a2e2997ce0bc5384517b5066b11bf7e91f978204599e99ac0a2e91a665917d2). This standard record adds no invented RF finding and does not rewrite or downgrade that historical high. I find no open current design issue in this narrow authoritative Norm addition.

APPROVE is limited to the same Goal/Task136 narrow specification-revision design. The frozen task spec remains 175297e180eea6b459a6d17ef4ca3010ef759fa35abd058a9ea689bf35535fac. The integrator must use the actual CLI escalation/resolution/classification/refreeze path, retain this genuine review by reference, freeze the revised spec and obtain independent review of its new current spec/design context before implementation. This record is not spec approval, action approval, implementation approval, code approval, source PASS or authority to reuse an old action/context. Fresh ordinary direct and sdist-rebuilt engines, contexts, single-use actions, pairs, complete lifecycles and full native/current required gates remain later work. No CI, actual target adoption or completed integration is claimed. This review launches no compiler, test, product or network process, exports no private material, and performs no commit, approval, escalation, resolution, spec/source modification or repair of failed originals; only the explicitly authorized formal review artifacts and normal review event are recorded.
